label: prompt_surface • custom host-folder agent ships the lean default tool surface
notes: A custom agent with a host folder and no opt-ins: `calculate` and the redaction pair (`detect_pii`, `redact_file`) are per-agent opt-ins, so they are absent, while the workspace core, file history, and the default-on loop tools stay. Composed with Raptor (compact-prompt class) so the census prices the small-model surface.
